title: Reviewing Requirement for Advance Medical Directives to be Signed in Doctor's Presence
what_it_is: Reviewing Requirement for Advance Medical Directives to be Signed in Doctor's Presence

sections.label: Advance Medical Directive signings
sections.summary: As of February 2026, more than 84,500 individuals have signed the Advance Medical Directive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As of February 2026, more than 84,500 individuals have signed the Advance Medical Directive (AMD).

sections.label: Doctor presence and AMD review
sections.summary: A doctor is required for clinical implications and soundness of mind, and the AMD process is being reviewed to increase uptake and simplify it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In relation to the first matter, as I have explained, and I think the Member is fully aware, the reason we require that a doctor be present for the purposes of this is, because there are clinical implications, there are clinical treatments that may require some explanation from the medical perspective, as well as the fact that you need to also ensure the soundness of mind of the individual.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I note the points raised, and actually, we are reviewing the whole AMD process to increase uptake and awareness on this; and also to streamline the processes to make it a lot simpler and accessible to the public.

sections.label: AMD Act safeguards and protocols
sections.summary: The AMD Act has exceptions and safeguards against inappropriate use, and records show the directive has been properly exercised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We want to ensure that this does not get raised inappropriately.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is governed by the AMD Act and within the Act, there are exceptions, safeguards that say that the doctor can talk about this as a concept, to describe and explain the process, with a view to protect against the inappropriate use of this matter.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Also, in our assessment, in terms of how the protocols are put in place, we are very conscious that this is a very time-sensitive process in a directive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And from our records, it does appear that it has been properly exercised.

sections.label: Doctors waiting for Registrar information
sections.summary: Doctors cannot ask patients or family members and must wait to call the Registrar for information.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng
sentences.text: And in my question, the scenario I painted is that, very often, those conditions where an AMD may be triggered often arrives in very inconvenient moments, like in the middle of the night.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuah Boon Theng
sentences.text: And the feedback I have obtained from doctors is that they literally have to wait because they are not allowed to ask the patient, they are not allowed to ask family members who have that information, and they have to wait until they have the opportunity to call the Registrar to obtain the information.

sections.label: Prompt responses to search requests
sections.summary: Responses to requests for the search have been prompt, even outside office hours.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: From our assessment, there have been very prompt responses, even outside office hours, in terms of following through with a request for the search.

sections.label: Doctor conversations with lucid patients
sections.summary: Nothing stops a doctor from talking with a conscious, lucid patient, and section 15(2) allows explaining AMD broadly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I would also highlight that in discussions with patient, when the patient is still very conscious and lucid, clearly nothing stops the doctor from having conversations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And in fact, as I highlighted, the exception in section 15(2), I believe, of the AMD Act allows for the doctor to have a conversation about AMD broadly, to explain the concept, to explain the directive.

sections.label: Feedback on concerns
sections.summary: The speaker notes concerns and will take the feedback back to colleagues to see if areas can be sharpened further.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But I think there are some concerns about it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I note the point, however, and this is feedback that I will take back to my colleagues to see if there are some other areas for which we can sharpen this further.
